notes.title: Gedel Escape is out on Steam
notes.notes:
[b]📅 Today is a remarkable and slightly mystical date 22.02.2022[/b]

Just today, my game Gedel Escape went into Early Access on Steam! It is already available for purchase and subsequent download, and for those who want to try the game before buying, there is a demo version with a truncated plot and functionality.

[b]💰 The cost of the game for Russian players is 195 rubles. In honor of the release until March 1, a 15% discount is available, so the game will cost 165 rubles.[/b]

The game is in early access, players have access to one of the three chapters of the game story called "Arrival". In it you will get acquainted with the game character, the main mechanics and the plot. Subsequently, the remaining two chapters will be released and made available to those who have purchased the game for free as updates. After the release of the entire game, its value will increase. Those who wish can already buy the game and after passing the first chapter, write a review on the Steam page.
